prompt: What was the official retail price per liter (in VND, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax) of RON 92-III gasoline on April 24, 2025, according to PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL)?
answer:
On April 24, 2025, **E5 RON92 gasoline**—the RON92 grade—was officially priced at **VND 19,238 per liter**, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax.  

*Note: “RON92-III” is not the usual designation; the other grade was RON95-III, priced at VND 19,638/liter.*
